notebooks.title: NeuraLeaf: Disentangled Neural Parametric Modeling of Leaf Shape, Deformation, and Appearance
notebooks.demonstration: Shape generation plus leaf deformation transfer and interpolation. The fitting example is a model-generated round-trip; appearance modeling and dataset-level benchmarks are outside this run.

preview.alt: Leaf shape and deformation results across four examples
preview.caption: Leaf shape and deformation results across four examples

notebooks.title: Seed Morphology in Key Spanish Grapevine Cultivars
notebooks.demonstration: Seed silhouette/model overlap and J-index for Albillo Real (30 seeds). Single-cultivar demo; scale-calibration discrepancy is documented.

preview.alt: Grapevine seed image and model overlap
preview.caption: Grapevine seed image and model overlap

notebooks.title: 3D sorghum reconstructions from depth images enable identification of quantitative trait loci regulating shoot architecture
notebooks.demonstration: Compares the authors’ and reproduced chromosome 4 QTL profiles for sorghum leaf length. Depth-image acquisition and 3D reconstruction are documented but not executed.

notebooks.title: Looking behind occlusions: A study on amodal segmentation for robust on-tree apple fruit size estimation
notebooks.demonstration: Amodal segmentation contours and depth maps for two apple images. Both runtime paths were validated; the saved outputs use CPU. Not a test-set performance evaluation.

preview.alt: Apple detections, amodal contours, and depth map
preview.caption: Apple detections, amodal contours, and depth map

notebooks.title: Deep aerenchyma: a transformer-based pipeline for scalable phenotyping of rice root aerenchyma lacunae across environments.
notebooks.demonstration: Segmentation overlays for three rice-root images. Not a multi-environment dataset-scale evaluation.

notebooks.title: DeepStomata: Facial Recognition Technology for Automated Stomatal Aperture Measurement
notebooks.demonstration: Stomata detections, four-class labels, and aperture overlays on one author-provided image. Paper-wide performance is not claimed.

notebooks.title: Operational Framework for Field-Scale Crop Sowing and Emergence Date Estimation Using Daily Synthetic Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 Time Series
notebooks.demonstration: Seasonal EVI fit and estimated phenological stages for one site-year (`goodwaterbau`, 2023). Not a multi-site reproduction.

preview.alt: Seasonal EVI and estimated phenological stages
preview.caption: Seasonal EVI and estimated phenological stages

notebooks.title: FQGR-net: Morphology-based litchi flower quantification and gender recognition.
notebooks.demonstration: Predicted male/female flower-density maps and masks on two author-provided samples. Not the 1,150-image benchmark; the code repository declares no license.

preview.alt: Litchi flowers with male/female point annotations
preview.caption: Litchi flowers with male/female point annotations

notebooks.title: Spatial analysis of cell patterning to aid genetic and phenotypic understanding of grass stomatal density: A case study in maize
notebooks.demonstration: Executed the pySPP SPP pipeline (ranked Manhattan NN, KDD heatmap, trait extraction, random-null OEScore) on the authors' shipped maize example; single genotype/replicate only — no SEM/QTL or population-level results.

preview.alt: SPP kernel density heatmap (±150 µm, 1 µm² kernels) for maize genotype Z019E0047 with two in-file neighbor hotspots flanking the origin.
preview.caption: SPP kernel density heatmap (±150 µm, 1 µm² kernels) for maize genotype Z019E0047 with two in-file neighbor hotspots flanking the origin.

notebooks.title: An artificial neural network-based deep learning model to predict combined stress impact and interaction in plants.
notebooks.demonstration: Runs the authors' published trained TANH ANN inference on their 21-row example (classification agreement 21/21 and zero regression deviation vs the authors' shipped Real_output.csv) plus a rice Control/Drought/Heat/D+H scenario; training reproduction is out of scope because the repository does not ship the training data.

preview.alt: Predicted plant performance for rice under individual vs combined drought-heat stress (ANN output, model-scaled units)
preview.caption: Predicted plant performance for rice under individual vs combined drought-heat stress (ANN output, model-scaled units)

notebooks.title: Automatic measurement of rice tiller angle from unmanned aerial vehicle images
notebooks.demonstration: Inference with the authors' released YOLO11-pose keypoint model and angle computation on the public UAV image subset on CPU; training and paper accuracy metrics are not reproduced.

preview.alt: Sample UAV rice image with detected 4-keypoint plant polygons and tiller angles from vertical
preview.caption: Sample UAV rice image with detected 4-keypoint plant polygons and tiller angles from vertical

notebooks.title: Stress phenotyping of wild desert legume Acacia senegal with machine learning application and phytochemical characterization of bipinnate leaves.
notebooks.demonstration: Runs the authors unmodified preprocessing and training pipeline on 200 bundled images (800 after augmentation), combining EfficientNetB0 features and six tabular variables with polynomial SVM. Fresh CPU and T4 runs passed; sample-scale metrics are not paper-level results.

preview.alt: Preprocessed 224x224 healthy and unhealthy Acacia senegal leaf samples entering the model
preview.caption: Preprocessed 224x224 healthy and unhealthy Acacia senegal leaf samples entering the model

notebooks.title: OpenEar: an ultra-affordable, high-throughput, and accurate maize ear phenotyping system.
notebooks.demonstration: Processes one author-provided maize video through frame correction, cylindrical projection, YOLO segmentation, ten trait calculations, and CNN quality control. Fresh CPU and T4 runs completed all 14 code cells with matching outputs; sample-scale demonstration only, not a dataset benchmark.

preview.alt: Kernel segmentation overlay from one author-provided maize video; one-sample demonstration.
preview.caption: Kernel segmentation overlay from one author-provided maize video; one-sample demonstration.

notebooks.title: Light dynamically regulates growth rate and cellular organisation of the Arabidopsis root meristem.
notebooks.demonstration: Ran the authors' iRoCS nuclei-analysis pipeline (SVM nucleus detection, epidermis labelling, iRoCS coordinate attachment, cell-layer assignment) end-to-end on the author sample DAPI root-tip stack and reproduced the paper's root-zonation model; partial demonstration on one DAPI-only sample, not the full atlas.

preview.alt: Nuclei detected by the iRoCS SVM pipeline, colored by assigned root layer over the DAPI projection.
preview.caption: Nuclei detected by the iRoCS SVM pipeline, colored by assigned root layer over the DAPI projection.

notebooks.title: The shape of aroma: measuring and modeling citrus oil gland distribution
notebooks.demonstration: One-sample reproduction of the citrus oil-gland ellipsoid fit, geocentric projection, k-NN, and five sphunif uniformity tests, validated against the author's outputs to ~1e-15; Directional/Bingham/vMF nulls omitted due to Rfast2 build time.

preview.alt: Gland centers and best-fit ellipsoid for citrus sample WR05_CRC3605_18B-19-5_L03
preview.caption: Gland centers and best-fit ellipsoid for citrus sample WR05_CRC3605_18B-19-5_L03

notebooks.title: LeafGen: Structure-aware Leaf Image Generation for Annotation-free Leaf Instance Segmentation.
notebooks.demonstration: Single-plant LeafGen pipeline (L-system Blender mask generation, GT instance masks, pretrained komatsuna pix2pix texturing) on CPU; dataset-scale generation, training, and downstream segmentation are out of scope.

preview.alt: LeafGen synthetic komatsuna plant textured with the pretrained pix2pix leaf generator (left) beside its auto-generated ground-truth instance mask (right).
preview.caption: LeafGen synthetic komatsuna plant textured with the pretrained pix2pix leaf generator (left) beside its auto-generated ground-truth instance mask (right).
